result.title: AstroMemBench: A Benchmark for Memory Systems in Embodied Spacecraft Agents
result.comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables. Includes Appendices A-E
result.summary: Long-term spacecraft autonomy requires embodied agents to use operational history under communication delays, time-critical operations, environmental uncertainty, complex physical interactions, power and computational constraints, and safety and reliability requirements. We introduce AstroMemBench and a Scenario-Challenge-Capability design method that maps these requirements to executable memory tests. The benchmark covers 16 memory subchallenges through 140 templates and 2240 instances across nine tasks in planetary surface operations, on-orbit servicing, and deep-space exploration. A deterministic environment scores actions for task completion, state changes, safety, and resource use. Ablations under nine conditions show that the benchmark is sensitive to how accurately agents recover and use historical information and to differences in memory-system design. Main experiments compare six configurations. Mem0, Chain-of-Memory, LightMem, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improve same-session mean scores over native Pi Agent, with no clear advantage of the three memory systems over RAG. After a session restart, Mem0 outperforms RAG by 12.25 points. Benefits favor instruction retention and result reuse over ongoing state tracking and energy reservation. AstroMemBench supports the design, development, and selection of memory systems for embodied spacecraft agents. AstroMemBench 1.0 and its evaluation code are publicly available: https://github.com/flyingView/AstroMemBench-v1.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AstroMemBench，面向具身航天器智能体的长期记忆系统基准：以「场景-挑战-能力」方法构建 16 类记忆子挑战、140 个模板和 2240 个实例，用确定性环境从任务完成、状态变化、安全与资源消耗打分，并比较 Mem0、Chain-of-Memory、LightMem、RAG 与原生 Pi Agent 等配置。
AI.relevance_reason: 其记忆子挑战分解与消融对「历史信息恢复准确性 vs 记忆系统设计」的区分，可供核查如何判定推理中状态与证据是否真被使用；「会话重启后 Mem0 优于 RAG」及收益偏向指令保持而非持续状态跟踪的结果，也可能为 latent 状态跟踪的价值假设提供旁证。
